WEIGHTED AVERAGE RoTCE (50%) RoTCE for each year is net income (less preferred dividends) divided by Average Tangible Common Equity for the year.
CUMULATIVE TBVPS (50%) Cumulative tangible book value per share (TBVPS) is determined by adding the TBVPS as of December 31, 2025, 2026 and 2027.

metrics.metric: Total shareholder return (TSR) modifier on PSUs
metrics.evidence: The number of PSUs that may be earned is capped at target if our TSR is negative over the three-year performance period, regardless of the outcome of the performance metrics.
